BE IT ORDAINED BY T H E CITY COUNCIL OF T H E C I T Y OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RT4 Residential Two-Fiat,

Townhouse and Multi-Unit District and the B3-2 Community Shopping District

symbols as shown on Map No. 19-H

in the area bounded by:



The public alley next north of and parallel to West Touhy Avenue; a line 106.40 feet

east of and parallel to North Clark Street, as measured along the northern boundary

line of West Touhy Avenue, and perpendicular thereto; West Touhy Avenue; North

Clark Street.



To those of a B3-2 Community Shopping Distnct
